# B2C

`sales.model.b2c` · model · parent `—`

> Selling to an individual for their own use. One person decides, usually quickly, often without speaking to anyone. Most of the qualification subdomain does not exist here, and loading it produces committee analysis on a customer who is buying a pair of shoes.


## Characteristics

|  |  |
|---|---|
| buyer | one individual, spending their own money |
| typical_cycle_days | 1 |
| typical_acv | two to four figures |
| committee_size | 1 |
| decision_style | individual, often emotional, frequently instant |
| primary_channels | `web`, `mobile`, `email`, `social` |

## Extends `sales.obj.core.decision_maker`


> In B2C the decision maker and the user are the same person, so authority_level is always final_approver and approval_limit is their own wallet. The object still loads; almost none of its inference machinery is needed.
